definition: Jeffrey Adgate Dean (born July 23, 1968) is an American computer scientist and software engineer.
details: Co-designed MapReduce, Bigtable, Spanner, DistBelief, TensorFlow, TPUs, and co-founded Google Brain. He is best known for his work at Google, which he joined in 1999. He led Google AI from 2018 to 2023 and was Google's chief scientist from 2023 to 2026.
